༄༅/ /gtum po khyung lnga'i sgrub thabs bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// gtum po khyung lnga'i sgrub thabs bzhugs so//

༄༅// "$ dpal phyag na rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo// dpal phyag na rdo rje'i rnal 'byor byed par 'dod pas/ stan bde ba la 'dug cing lus ci bde bar bsdad la/ dang po chos thams cad stong par bsgom/ de nas sems can thams cad snying re rje snyam du bsam/ de nas bdag nyid gtum po'i skur langs la sems can gyi don bya snyam du bsam/ de'i rjes la stong pa'i ngang la nyi ma'i dal cig bsam/ de'i steng du hūm̐ mthing nag 'bar ba cig bsam/ de las 'od 'phros pas 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas tshur 'dus pa las/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad 'od du zhu nas rdo rje mthing nag 'bar ba las/ hūm̐ mthing nag 'bar bas mtshan pa zhig bsam/ ngag tu oṃ badz+ra pā ṇi hūm̐ phaṭ ces brjod pas/ de rnams yongs su gyur pa las bdag rdo rje gtum po zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum pa/ sku mdog sngon po/ phyag g.yas na rdo rje rtse lnga pa 'phyar ba/ g.yon par dril bu sku la brten pa/ stag lpags kyi sham thabs can/ 'jigs su rung ba'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ gdan pad+ma dang zla ba dang*/ nyi ma'i steng na zhabs g.yon brkyangs pas dbang phyug chen po kha dog sngon po mnan pa/ g.yas bskums pas u ma de ba kha dog dmar po mnan pa/ me ri me dpung gi gseb na bdag nyid gnas par bsgom mo// de nas spyi bor go bsgo ba la gnyis te rdo rje'i go bgo ba ni rdo rje rgya gram gyi lte bar hūm̐ gnas par bsams la/ ngag tu oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐ zhes brjod pas/ spyi bo'i rdo rje'i lte ba'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas spyi bo nas rkang mthil yan chad rdo rje'i zhu lugs su gyon par bsam/ de nas ngag tu oṃ badz+ra ga ru ḍa hūm̐ zhes brjod pas snying gar rdo rje'i khyung sgrub pa la khyung gi go bgo ba la gnyis las bsnyen pa la yig 'brus cho ga sngon po phyag g.yas rdo rje/ g.yon sbrul sngo khra bzung ba/

mchu dang sgro gshog thams cad rdo rje'i rang bzhin du bsam/ pa dang gcig bud+dha ga ru ḍa oṃ zhes brjod pas spyi bor 'khor lo'i khyung g.yas 'khor lo dang g.yon sbrul dkar khra bzung ba mchu sgro thams cad 'khor lo dkar po dang gnyis pad+ma ga ru ḍa hrīḥ zhes pas mgrin par pad+ma'i khyung g.yas pad+ma dang g.yon sbrul dmar khra bzung ba mchu sgro thams cad pad+ma dmar po/ dang gsum/ rat+na ga ru ḍa trām̐ zhes pas lte bar rin po che'i g.yas rin po che dang g.yon sbrul ser khra mchu dang sgro thams cad rin po che khyung ser po/ dang bzhi/ karma ga ru ḍa āḥ ces pas gsang bar g.yas ral gri g.yon sbrul ljang khu mchu gshog thams cad ral gri ral gri'i khyung ljang khu bsam mo// pa dang lnga'o// ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' bsgom pa ni/ de nas snying gyen la log pas pad+ma 'dab bzhir gyes pa'i steng du nyi ma/ de'i steng du rdo rje mthing nag 'bar ba'i lte ba la nyi ma zhig bsam/ nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ nag po zhig bsam/ ye shes sems dpa' spyan drangs pa ni/ de nas snying ga'i rdo rje'i lte ba las sna bug g.yas nas phar 'od zer 'phros song ba dang*/ bdag gi ngag tu/ hūm̐ bde gshegs gtso bo gtum po dang*// lha rnams phyogs su 'khod pa dag /bdag dang sems can rgyud sbyang phyir// skad cig tsam gyis gshegs su gsol// e h+ya hi bha ga wān/ mahā ka ru ṇi ka hoḥs ma ya dzaḥs ma ya s+t+waṃ/ badz+ra aṅgu sha dza/ zhes brjod pa dang*/ snying ga'i 'od zer gyis ye shes sems dpa' bdag nyid 'dra ba zhig dang phyogs bcu sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad mdun gyi nam mkhar byon par bsam la/ yi ge brgya pa tshar gcig brjod pas spyi khrus gsol bar bsam/ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ sa ma ya dzaḥ zhes brjod pas yon chab phul bas zhal bsil bar bsam/ oṃ a pra ba ra sadakar a tsit+ti swā hā/ zhabs bsil bar bsam/ oṃ ka ma la ye swā hā/

zhes pas me tog cig phul bas gdan la bzhugs pa la bdun rnam dag bya ba ni/ gang gis 'khor ba'i nyes pa ni// dran pa tsam gyis 'joms mdzad cing*// bla med byang chub thob mdzad pa'i// bla ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// lcang lo can gyi pho brang na// bcom ldan rdo rje gtum po ni// yon tan thams cad sku la rdzogs// skyon med sku la phyag 'tshal lo// chos nyid stong pa'i ngang las ma g.yos kyang*// smon lam dbang gis khyung chen skur sprul nas// thabs la mkhas phyir sna tshogs skur ston pa// rgyal sras khyung gi tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo// phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i 'phags pa thams cad la// bdag gis ci nus dmigs pa'i mchod 'bul na// kun tu bzang po'i mchod sprin chen po ltar// sku gsung thugs la mnyes pa'i mchod gyur cig /oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa badz+ra puṣ+pe pra tīts+tsha hūm̐ swā hā/ zhes brjod pas lha mo me tog ma dkar mo phyag na me tog thogs pa rang gi snying ga nas bton la ye shes sems dpa'i spyi bor bstim mo// badz+ra dhū pe pra tīts+tsha hūm̐ swā hā/ zhes pas des 'gre bar bdug spos ma sngon mo dang*/ badz+ra ā lo ke pra tīts+tsha hūm̐ swā hā/ zhes pas mar me ma dmar mo dang*/ badz+ra gan+dhe pra tīts+tsha hūm̐ swā hā/ zhes pas dri chab ma ljang khu dang*/ badz+ra ne wai d+ya pra tīts+tsha hūm̐ swā hā/ zhes pas zhal zas ma ser mo dang*/ badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍa ra ṇa pra tī ts+tsha hūm̐ swā hā/ zhes pas rol mo ma khra mo rnams bdag gi thugs ka nas bton la shangs dang spyan dang thugs dang snyan du bstim mo// de nas bdag gis thog ma med dus nas// sdig pa ma lus bgyis pa rnams// bcom ldan phyag na rdo rje yi// spyan sngar so sor bshags par bgyis// shes rab snying rjer ldan pa'i byang chub sems// dus gsum rgyal bas ji ltar bskyed pa bzhin// de yi rjes su bdag gis bskyed par bgyi// byang chub sems de nam yang mi gtang ngo*// bla ma rdo rje 'chang dang ni// gsang sngags kun bdag rdo rje 'chang*// rig pa 'dzin pa'i rnal 'byor rnams// dge ba mdzad la rjes yi rangs// bcom ldan phyag na rdo rje dang*// 'khor dang bcas la lus 'bul na// bzhes nas bdag la rjes mthun pa'i// dngos grub rnam gnyis stsal du gsol// dang po byang chub sems bskyed nas// da lta dge ba gang bsags pa// bdag dang sems can don slad du// byang chub chen por bsngo bar bgyi// zhes brjod la bstod pa 'dis bstod do// 'gro ba kun gyi dpal gyur pa// mthu stobs dpal ldan rdo rje phyag

/gdug pa ma lus kun 'dul mdzad// mthu stobs can la phyag 'tshal bstod// gang gis gang la ci 'dul ba// sna tshogs skur ni ston par byed// khyung chen nyid du sprul byas nas// klu gnyan 'dul la phyag 'tshal bstod// yang sprul bye ba bsam mi khyab// sprul pa'i khyung ni glog stong 'khyug /klu srin dgu brgya'i snying nas 'byin// 'gro ba skyob la phyag 'tshal bstod// khams gsum sems can thams cad la// mi ma yin gyis 'tshe byed pa// 'joms phyir khyung chen sku sprul pa// 'gro don mdzad la phyag 'tshal bstod// rnam rtog 'joms mdzad thugs rje'i bdag /so so'i rigs kyi skur ston pa// khyung chen lngar ni rab tu grags// bgegs rigs 'joms la phyag 'tshal bstod// mthu stobs dpal ldan rdo rje phyag /sprul pa bye ba bsam mi khyab// phyogs bcu kun tu 'gyed mdzad pa// 'gro ba skyob la phyag 'tshal bstod// e ma bde gshegs thugs rje spyan// rtag tu ma yengs sems can don// 'gro don rtag tu mdzad pa'o// rnam rtog 'joms la phyag 'tshal bstod// chos kyi dbyings kyi pho brang na// 'jigs byed chen po khro bo ni// sangs rgyas kun gyi sprul pa'i sku// dbang bskur mchog la= dpa' bo chen po thabs mnyes pa// sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje yis// gdug pa ma lus 'joms mdzad pa/ rdo rje can la= bcom ldan mgon po rdo rje can// ut+pal sngon po'i mdog 'dra ba'i// khro bo'i gzugs su rnam par sprul// 'joms par byed pa 'jigs byed pa// rdo rje sdigs mdzub phyag rgya can// gtum po de la= gtum zhing dul ba brjid pa'i sku// sna tshogs las rnams mdzad pa po// thogs med yid bzhin nor bu'i tshul// rdo rje'i sku la= dngos po thams cad rnam dag kyang*// smon lam stobs kyis sgra byung ba// tshig dang bral ba sna tshogs sgra// yid bzhin sgra 'byung khyod la bstod// 'jigs pa'i hūm̐ sgra nges par sgrog

/bgegs rnams ma lus sreg mdzad cing*// dngos grub thams cad stsol mdzad pa// bgegs kyi dgra la= ji ltar sku gsum mtha' yas kyang*// dngos po med cing mtshan ma med// rnam dag dbyings las ma g.yos pa'i// thugs rje'i thugs la= ye shes gnyis med tshul 'chang zhing*// theg chen rtogs dka' thugs su chud// gsang sngags rgyal po gsang 'dzin pa// gsang bdag rdo rje 'chang la 'dud// ji ltar nor bu yid bzhin mdzod// de ltar yon tan mdzod gyur na// sems can re ba skong mdzad pa'i// rdo rje nor bu khyod la 'dud// sku yi gsang ba ma lus khyod ston cing*// gsung gi gsang ba thun mong ma yin gsung*// thugs kyi gsang ba rtogs dka' khyod kyis rtogs// sku gsung thugs kyi bdag la phyag 'tshal bstod// khyod ni rdo rje gtum chen te// klu bdud 'byung po kun 'dul nas// drag po rab 'bar stobs po che// rdo rje gtum po khyod la 'dud// drag por gyur pa 'dul ba'i phyir// sdigs mdzub rtse las 'od byung bas// gdug pa thams cad kun 'dul ba'i// thogs med rdo rje khyod la 'dud// ces bstod la/ de'i rjes la yi ge brgya pa brjod de/ oṃ badz+ra pā ṇi sa mā yā/ ma nu pā la ya/ badz+ra pā ṇi te no pa tiṣ+ṭha/ ḍi ḍho me bha ba/ su to ṣ+yo me bha wa/ a nu rak+to me bha wa/ su po ṣ+yo me bha wa/ sarba sid+dhim+me pra yats+tsha/ sarba karma su tsa me/ tsit+taṃ shri yaṃ ku ru hūm̐/ ha ha ha ha hoḥ bha ga wān/ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra pā ṇi mā me muñtsa/ badz+ri bha wa/ ma hā sa ma ya satwa āḥ zhes brjod pas lhag chad dang nyes dmigs thams cad bskang nas/ mdun gyi ye shes sems dpa' de dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs/ bstim la bskal pa ma stongs bar du bzhugs par bsam mo// de'i rjes la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis bdag la dbang bskur du gsol zhes brjod pas/ ye shes sems dpa' dang dus mtshungs su byon pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi thugs ka nas rig pa'i lha mo rin po che'i bum pa bdud rtsi'i chus bkang ba dpag tu med pa byung nas/

bdag gi spyi bo nas mar chu blugs shing*/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni// de bzhin gshegs kun khrus gsol ltar// lha yi chu ni dag pa yis// de bzhin bdag gis khrus bgyi'o// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ bdag gi lus ngag yid gsum gyi dri ma dag nas chu rgyun tha ma 'khyil bas mi bskyod pas dbu rgyan par bsam mo// pa ni bskyed pa'i rim pa'i rnal 'byor ro// de nas rang gtum por gnas pa'i snying gar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du ye shes sems dpa' tshon gang ba/ bsam gtan gyi rnal 'byor ro// de'i snying pad+ma 'dab bzhir gyes pa'i steng gi rdo rje'i lte ba la pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma bzhi pa zhig bsam/ pad+ma'i lte ba la thig le sngon po sran chung tsam gcig bsam/ thig le la sems ji tsam gnas kyi bar du bsgom mo// de nas bzlas pa bya ba ni/ yang snying ga'i rdo rje'i lte ba la nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor zhig bsam/ de'i dbus su hūm̐ mthing nag 'bar ba gcig bsam/ nyi ma'i tha ma nang bar la oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa badz+ra ga ru ḍa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ ga ru ḍa tsa le tsa le hūm̐ phaṭ duṣ+ṭaṃ mā ra ya swā hā/ zhes pa hūm̐ la bskor nas yod par bsam/ bzlas pa'i rnal 'byor ro// bdag gi ngag tu sngags de nyid sbrul mgo langs pa ltar rtsa yi nang nas mar la song*/ chu so nas thon zhal du zhugs/ de ltar 'khor ba la sems gtad do// bzlas pa byed pa'i dus su skyon lnga spangs la bzlas so// bzlas pas skyo na skabs 'dir gtor ma btang ngo*// zas kyi rnal 'byor za ba'i dus su yang*/ zas gtor ma ltar byin gyis brlabs la/ sum mdo rlung gi dkyil 'khor/ pho ba me'i dkyil 'khor/ snying gar phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad gtum po'i ngo bor bskyed la/ bla ma yang bskyed/ lag pa hom gzar/ kha hom khung*/ zas sreg rdzas su bsams la/

snying kha'i lha la mchod par bsams la bza'o// de nas rjes kyi dus su/ thun mtshams thams cad du rang gtum por gnas pa'i phyag mtshan thugs kar bsdus la/ spyi bor bla ma dang ma bral bar spyod lam thams cad bya'o// sdig pa phra zhing phra ba'i dri mas kyang ma gos par bya'o// rdo rje dril bu la mi 'gong bar rtag tu bcang*/ me tog sngon po la mi 'gong*/ khyung gi dam tshig tu bya sha dang sgo nga mi bza'/ mi gtsang ba la 'dzem/ ma grub bar du rta sha'ang mi bza'/ klu gtor rgyun du btang*/ rdo rje gtum po'i mngon par rtogs pa gtsang pa rgya ras pas gong ma'i gsung bzhin du bkod pa rdzogs so// 'gro ba la phan thogs par gyur cig /sarba maṅgalaṃ/// /
